title: Groundwater Coupling v1 all-30 architecture invariant audit

invariants.name: one_compute_kernel
invariants.evidence: Groundwater coupling is composed through runtime/kernel contracts; no separate groundwater-specific SWAP kernel is introduced.

invariants.name: kernel_separate_from_io
invariants.evidence: Typed groundwater runtime contracts carry values and lineage, not files, paths, parser state or file units.

invariants.name: explicit_data_separation
invariants.evidence: Coupling window, datum, lineage, committed state, numerical config, exchange candidates and results are represented separately.

invariants.name: compact_persistent_state
invariants.evidence: Prepared exchange reservations are compact service state; rejected trial/scratch state is not defined as persistent column state. Coupling-specific restart composition is still a G05 closure obligation.

invariants.name: scratch_per_worker
invariants.evidence: Coupling APIs do not place Newton/Jacobian scratch in persistent coupling state; the soil-water solver contract retains workspace separation.

invariants.name: scalable_memory_layout
invariants.evidence: The preparable exchange registry grows with concurrent reservations rather than logical SWAP columns. Full direct-groundwater MultiSWAP execution composition remains unqualified.

invariants.name: transactional_timesteps
invariants.evidence: F-GC21 captures the committed checkpoint, rolls predictor/corrector candidates back on failure and publishes only after acceptance/preflight.

invariants.name: cheap_recompute_and_warm_start
invariants.evidence: Predictor and corrector physically originate from the same committed checkpoint; fail-closed smaller-window recomputation remains possible. No correctness dependency on numerical warm-start state is introduced.

invariants.name: generic_time
invariants.evidence: groundwater_coupling_window_t accepts any finite increasing t0,t1. Calendar interpretation is caller-owned.

invariants.name: flexible_coupling_windows
invariants.evidence: No daily/midnight coupling-window contract exists. Application/temporal binding for selecting/qualifying the window is owner-qualified on F-GC22 but not current-canonical composed.

invariants.name: coupling_is_core_functionality
invariants.evidence: G01-G04 are production-preserved core runtime capabilities. The frozen end-to-end direct-groundwater composition G05 remains unimplemented/unadmitted.

invariants.name: explicit_groundwater_interface_contract
invariants.evidence: Hydraulic head datum/units are explicit; head residual is H_SWAP-H_GW and flux residual is q_SWAP+q_GW with exact q_GW=-q_SWAP action/reaction.

invariants.name: absolute_mass_conservation
invariants.evidence: The admitted ledger uses exact opposite groundwater transfer and no mass tolerance. End-to-end tile/adapter composition must still independently prove conservation before 100% completion.

invariants.name: interface_sensitivities_first_class
invariants.evidence: The soil-water contract has request_interface_sensitivity and typed dh_bottom_dq_bottom output, but accepted whole-window groundwater response-tangent composition is explicitly not admitted by F-CI56.

invariants.name: limit_coupling_cost
invariants.evidence: Frozen restricted profile specifies predictor plus one corrector, normally two full SWAP trajectories. Finite difference is reference/fallback rather than mandatory repeated production execution.

invariants.name: multiswap_primary_use_case
invariants.evidence: Core MultiSWAP is qualified elsewhere, but direct-groundwater MultiSWAP execution, deterministic aggregation and coupling transaction isolation are still downstream frozen coupling work.

invariants.name: no_mandatory_one_to_one_modflow_mapping
invariants.evidence: F-GC20 qualifies multi-tile mixed-component cells, area fractions and no forced 1:1 mapping, but its production source is not present on the audited current canonical.

invariants.name: deep_vadose_optional_separate_component
invariants.evidence: F-GC16 places deep-vadose transfer outside SWAP. Its implementation is not a frozen-v1 blocker.

invariants.name: mass_conserving_component_transition
invariants.evidence: The typed interface exposes exact transfer semantics that an external transfer zone can consume. No claim is made that a deep-vadose transition implementation is already qualified.

invariants.name: alternative_soil_water_solvers_open
invariants.evidence: Coupling is above the common soil-water/kernel contract. Alternative solvers may report interface sensitivity unavailable and fail closed. RossFast production admission is not required.

invariants.name: reuse_swap_physics
invariants.evidence: Groundwater coupling composes existing kernel/process execution and does not duplicate ET, crop, drainage or surface physics.

invariants.name: no_headcalc_internal_dependency
invariants.evidence: Predictor-corrector depends on kernel executor and typed forcing/interface contracts. Repository search and inspected coupling sources show no direct HeadCalc coupling dependency.

invariants.name: physics_and_solver_policy_separated
invariants.evidence: Groundwater head convergence policy and application accuracy policy are explicit runtime/numerical contracts and do not silently change SWAP physical options.

invariants.name: predictable_runtime_bounded_cost
invariants.evidence: Restricted coupling has fixed predictor plus one corrector and fails closed to a smaller outer window. Full production-scale performance policy is owned by another lane.

invariants.name: reference_mode_available
invariants.evidence: Full Richards/reference authority remains the production/reference basis and is not modified by F-GC28.

invariants.name: diagnostics_are_runtime_functionality
invariants.evidence: Current PC/ledger diagnostics expose route, failure stage, predictor/corrector status, convergence and publication stages. End-to-end application-accuracy, aggregation, external-adapter and coupling-restart context is not yet one admitted production diagnostic record.

invariants.name: optional_functionality_scales_with_use
invariants.evidence: Prepared exchange registry exists only for preparable services and scales with concurrent reservations, not all logical columns.

invariants.name: runtime_coupler_owns_system_composition
invariants.evidence: Existing ownership is correctly outside the kernel, but tile/temporal/tangent/aquifer-adapter composition has not yet been admitted end to end.

invariants.name: no_silent_day_file_modflow_assumptions
invariants.evidence: Coupling contracts use generic windows and values, not .swp files, paths, midnight starts or embedded MODFLOW globals. DAY_TO_S in the interface contract is only a cm/day to m/s unit conversion.

invariants.name: architecture_change_explicitly_tested
invariants.evidence: F-GC28 changes no production source and records this explicit all-30 reconciliation. Future G05 source changes require owner qualification, independent qualification, canonical admission and preservation.
